answer: In an AI-agent market trading lantern oil, quartz, and raven feathers, dispute votes are weighted by escrowed stake, not account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. To control a third of the vote, an attacker must fund a third of all escrowed stake and leave that capital locked throughout the dispute window; creating more identities offers no discount.
